news.title: Sweet Solution: O’Neill School research reveals powerful link between chocolate and carbon sequestration
news.summary_en: New O’Neill School research finds well-managed cacao agroforestry can boost soil carbon storage, supporting climate resilience, biodiversity, and sustainable agriculture.

news.title: Innovation, not subsidies, drives resurgence of hybrid electric vehicles in the U.S.
news.summary_en: New O’Neill School research finds hybrid vehicles are resurging through innovation, helping replace gas-powered cars and reduce emissions without relying on incentives.
